'''Hervack Spaceport''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Steelious]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] used Hervack Spaceport as a hub for moving supplies around the [[Sector/Legends|sector]].
